exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Languages How many languages can you speak? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How useful will English be to you in your future? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: What do you remember about learning languages at school? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: What do you think would be the hardest language for you to learn? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a website that you bought something from. You should say: what the website is what you bought from this website how satisfied you were with what you bought and explain what you liked or disliked about using this website.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Shopping online What kinds of things do people in your country often buy from online shops?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do you think online shopping has become so popular nowadays?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: What are some possible disadvantages of buying things from online shops?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: The culture of consumerism Why do many people today keep buying things which they do not need?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you believe the benefits of a consumer society outweigh the disadvantages?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: How possible is it to avoid the culture of consumerism?
